# OpenAI Agent Plugins package

This generated P-ASES package contains portable Agent Plugins metadata at `plugin.json`, the canonical 16 Skills under `skills/`, shared standards/templates, and the local `p_ases` runtime. Register `https://github.com/puchinya/ai-agent-workflow` as a marketplace in Codex, then install `p-ases`. The generated `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` entry uses `./dist/openai`, resolved inside the marketplace checkout. Refresh the marketplace in Codex after repository updates.

Marketplace installation reads the GitHub repository snapshot; it does not download a Release asset. Use the versioned OpenAI Release ZIP and `SHA256SUMS` when you need a pinned or offline manual install.

To use the CLI from a consumer checkout, install this directory with `python -m pip install /path/to/dist/openai`, then run `python -m p_ases --help`. `python -m p_ases project status` reads an existing profile; it does not initialize or change one. The source of truth is `workflow/`, `runtime/p_ases/`, and this adapter. Run `python tools/build_dist.py` from the repository root after editing canonical files.

For approved ADC work, the `work-execution` Skill resolves the selected base ref and SHA before requesting isolation. Codex's native managed worktree or task-fork capability is preferred when the current surface exposes it. Select the approved starting branch/ref when supported and verify the resulting HEAD equals the selected SHA. If the current surface cannot guarantee that exact base, `workspace.isolation=auto` falls back to the current checkout and `required` blocks before edits. This plugin does not create sibling worktrees or shell out to another Codex process. Product behavior has not been smoke-tested by this repository workflow.


For the one-time `puchinya/ai-agent-workflow` Issue #63 / PR #64 adoption, bootstrap implementation and exact-final-HEAD Required CI must finish before a full immutable adoption plan is presented. Obtain a separate direct same-conversation Owner approval for that exact plan through the authenticated V3 in-process route, then apply and read back the prospective adopted epoch; do not synthesize the missing historical Binding or report ordinary PASS evidence before adoption. If the active Codex surface cannot provide the actual current user-role event, stop with `CHAT_PROVENANCE_UNAVAILABLE`. After adoption, Independent Review must bind `execution-adoption:<epoch-sha256>` and all normal lifecycle gates continue. This decision authorizes no User Review, Ruleset, Activation, or merge.

The host owns one lifecycle orchestration for ordinary single/child Issues: exact approved ADC/rebaseline and Binding, specification/design/Test Oracle receipts, `ready`, `execution`, implementation, current Verification/Acceptance/Self-Audit and fresh native Independent Review, then `verification`, Review Readiness, and `user-review start`. Keep fixes for blocking Independent Review findings in `execution`; each changed HEAD needs a fresh child. Do not move verification back to execution implicitly. Runtime commands remain one-shot mutations and readbacks. Readiness cannot PASS before verification or while any `attention:*` label is present; attention is cleared only through the existing attention workflow. User Review validates exact kind/phase/attention before writes, and re-reads all three before its label update. A lost label-write response is resolved by exact full-label readback without repeating a confirmed write. In `user-review`, Readiness can only recompute the same subject/Readiness SHA already held by its immutable session. Start/sync resumes an exact interrupted session without changing `started_at`. Treat `PENDING` (exit code 2) as `WAITING_USER_REVIEW_DECISION` only after session, complete snapshot, and `phase:user-review` readback; no approval is implied.

Independent Review requires a dedicated fresh subagent actually created and joined through the active Codex host's native delegation surface, with a child-authored result for the exact current subject. Missing host spawn/session, reviewer, or implementation-binding IDs alone do not block; the runtime records `LIMITED` confidence and the missing values. When all three IDs are available and match, it records `HIGH`. No child result, failed/unknown spawn or join, same-context result, stale evidence, or available mismatching binding blocks. The parent ingests the unchanged artifact through `audit independent`; a second prompt in the same context, human fallback, or User Review is not a substitute.

For the already adopted Issue #63 / PR #64 epoch, a later approved ADC stays a forward continuation: preserve the epoch and adoption journal, wait for that ADC generation's V2 Phase Applied record, then run only `work adoption-refresh 63 --repo puchinya/ai-agent-workflow --root .`. The host verifies the exact current ADC/HEAD PRBinding V3 and V2 checkpoint readback. `work recover` remains read-only, same-generation `pr ensure` cannot bridge an ADC generation, and no new adoption approval or adoption journal is created.
